title: Bored piles for a reconstructed stadium: refused code compliance certificate and producer statements

facts.text: The stadium was completed in 2000 and a velodrome was linked in 2004; in 2010 part of the stadium collapsed after a snowstorm, and it was reconstructed in 2011 to 2016 under several consents and amendments.

Foundation work was supported by producer statements: PS1 design by the engineering company, PS4 construction review by the project engineer, and PS3 construction statements for the drilling company and the contractor.
Figure 1 is a site plan sketch (p.4); Figure 2 shows the bored piles (p.5).
The matter is the authority's refusal of a code compliance certificate for the foundation work under building consent 2011/101, with concerns about aspects of the PS3 and PS4 statements.
